```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: game-epa
# The game's scrimmage plays, with each play's EPA from the expected points
# curve fit on every 2026 scrimmage play, then the running total per offense.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
run <- game_running(epa)
tot <- run |>
  summarise(total = sum(ppa), plays = n(), per_play = mean(ppa), .by = offense)
mz_low <- run |>
  filter(offense == away) |>
  slice_min(cum_ppa, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
ga_end <- tot$total[tot$offense == home]
mz_end <- tot$total[tot$offense == away]
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(run, aes(game_min, cum_ppa, color = offense)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(15, 30, 45), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate(
    "point",
    x = mz_low$game_min,
    y = mz_low$cum_ppa,
    shape = 4,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = mz_low$game_min + 1,
    y = mz_low$cum_ppa - 4,
    label = paste0(away, " low: ", round(mz_low$cum_ppa, 1)),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = "Offense") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60), limits = c(0, 60)) +
  labs(
    title = "Running total of EPA by offense",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Scrimmage plays with an EPA, game minutes; dashed lines mark quarter breaks"
    ),
    x = "Game minutes elapsed",
    y = "Cumulative EPA",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-epa-running-total", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: agreement
# What CFBD's PPA measures: the change in expected points across each play,
# read off the curve (the model above), against the published PPA. Every
# other exhibit on this card runs on PPA itself.
rated <- dplyr::filter(epa, !is.na(ppa))
epa_cor <- cor(rated$epa_mine, rated$ppa, use = "complete.obs")
gap_play <- rated |>
  slice_max(abs(epa_mine - ppa), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
p_agree <- rated |>
  ggplot(aes(ppa, epa_mine, color = offense)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "22") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        offense,
        "</b><br>",
        playText,
        "<br>CFBD PPA: ",
        round(ppa, 2),
        "<br>Expected points before: ",
        round(ep_before, 2),
        ", after: ",
        round(ep_after, 2),
        "<br>Change in expected points: ",
        round(epa_mine, 2)
      )
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = "Offense") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-10, 5), ylim = c(-10, 5)) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = gap_play$ppa + 3.6,
    y = gap_play$epa_mine + 1.6,
    xend = gap_play$ppa + 0.25,
    yend = gap_play$epa_mine + 0.1,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in expected points against CFBD's PPA, play by play",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Correlation ",
      round(epa_cor, 2),
      "; the diagonal is where the two agree"
    ),
    x = "CFBD PPA for the play",
    y = "Change in expected points across the play",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card(base_size = 16)
card_interactive(p_agree, width_svg = 9, height_svg = 6.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
tot |>
  transmute(
    Offense = offense,
    Plays = plays,
    `Total EPA` = round(total, 1),

  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Offense", "Plays", "Total EPA", "EPA per play"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Total and per-play EPA by offense over the ",
      sum(tot$plays),
      " scrimmage plays of the game that carry an EPA."
    )
  )
```
